title: OrcaRalphTask
description: Schema for individual task definitions within the Orca Ralph execution engine.

title.description: Brief description of the task objective.

assigned_agent.description: Agent name assigned to execute the task (e.g. senior-backend-engineer).

dependencies.description: Task IDs that must complete successfully before this task can start.

acceptance_criteria.description: Specific, verifiable conditions required for completion.

verification_commands.description: Shell commands executed to verify completion (e.g. npm test, pytest, tsc).

evidence_required.description: Evidence types required before passing evaluation.

worktree_path.description: Git worktree path dedicated to this task.
